svg.text: Each line joins an account to an IP address it used; the number on the line is that account's
records on that IP (exports/ip_accounts.csv). Accounts are linked when they used the same IP;
IPs used by more than 25 accounts are treated as shared infrastructure and do not link; address
classes that link: public, documentation. The accent marks the closest co-use each finding
